tasks.name: Export telemetry from the API and worker, with trace-correlated console logs
inputs: design.md Architecture items 1 and 9, API Design configuration
effect/unstable/observability: Otlp.layerFromConfig, OtlpSerialization.layerProtobuf; effect/unstable/http FetchHttpClient
apps/api/src/index.ts (NodeRuntime.runMain(Layer.launch(main))) and apps/api/src/worker.ts (ManagedRuntime over store + worker layers)
effect-mq forks worker loops at layer-build time (node_modules effect-mq Worker.js ~l.570, 779)
Run pnpm install in the worktree first; it has no node_modules
tasks.description: Create makeTelemetryLayer({ serviceName, environment }) composed as Otlp.layerFromConfig({ resource: { serviceName, attributes: { 'deployment.environment.name' } } }) piped through Layer.provideMerge(consoleLoggerLayer), Layer.provide(OtlpSerialization.layerProtobuf), Layer.provide(FetchHttpClient.layer). provideMerge keeps the console logger alongside the OTLP logger whether export is enabled or not. The console logger in production is JSON built with Logger.map(Logger.formatStructured, ...) adding traceId and spanId from fiber.currentSpan (consoleJson omits them); outside production it is Logger.consolePretty. Service names are exchequer-api and exchequer-worker. In index.ts apply the layer with Layer.provide to the serveApp(...) result (main) so it is outermost. In worker.ts apply it with Layer.provide underneath the merged store+worker layer, NOT as a sibling in Layer.mergeAll, so effect-mq's forked loops inherit the tracer and logger. Never wrap the server layer or the launch in a span: HttpApiBuilder merges the build-time context over the request context and every error would report that one span's trace. Document OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=otlp, OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS as commented-out entries in apps/api/.env.example and in docker-compose.yml for the api and worker services. No new dependencies and nothing added to the Config class.

new_abstractions.name: makeTelemetryLayer
new_abstractions.requirement: US-1 export via OTEL_* with no-op when unset; US-5 trace-correlated structured logs

tests: with a pinned empty ConfigProvider (not process.env) the layer builds and tears down cleanly and an effect run under it succeeds

with the three OTEL_*_EXPORTER variables set to otlp and the endpoint pointing at an unreachable port, an effect run under the layer still succeeds and shutdown completes within the exporter shutdown timeout
in the production environment a log emitted inside Effect.withSpan produces a JSON line containing that span's traceId and spanId
acceptance: Layer.provide ordering places the telemetry layer under the worker layer, not beside it
No span wraps the server layer or the launch in index.ts
pnpm --filter=@exchequerio/api types passes
Starting the API with no OTEL_* variables exports nothing and logs as pretty console output

tasks.name: Count idempotency claim outcomes and trace idempotency Valkey calls
inputs: design.md Architecture items 2, 4 and 8, US-6
apps/api/src/lib/IdempotencyService.ts IdempotencyServiceRedis.claim (l.170-187), awaitResultId polling, and the four ioredis call sites (eval/get)

tasks.description: Create lib/metrics.ts exporting two Metric.counters: idempotency_claims (attribute outcome) and ledger_transactions_posted (attribute path). Never use organization or ledger ids as metric attributes. In IdempotencyServiceRedis.claim record outcome new (SET succeeded), replay (stored id returned), pending (IdempotencyPending failure) or unavailable (IdempotencyUnavailable failure). Wrap each of the four ioredis calls in a valkey.<COMMAND> client span (kind client) with db.system.name=valkey and db.operation.name set to the command; never record keys. Keep the span helper local to IdempotencyService unless T5 needs the same helper, in which case extract it then.

tests: claim on a fresh key increments idempotency_claims{outcome=new} by 1
claim on a completed key increments outcome=replay by 1
claim on a pending key that never completes fails IdempotencyPending and increments outcome=pending by 1
claim against a failing store fails IdempotencyUnavailable and increments outcome=unavailable by 1
acceptance: Spans contain db.system.name and db.operation.name and no key material
Counters carry no id attributes
IdempotencyService public interface and error types unchanged
